name: AceON Accelerator
decision_note: Prague online accelerator founded by Accace and ZAKA VC that gives EUR 40k SAFE/CLA tickets to demo-day winners (two startups, Nov 2024), but no AceON legal entity or investing vehicle can be identified and no Czech portfolio company was found.

evidence.quote: AceON Accelerator was founded right in the center of Europe, in Prague, by two global companies, Accace and ZAKA VC.
AceON Accelerator delivers its 6th program for European idea and pre-seed stage startups, combining hands-on know-how, a global founders’ community, and access to investment.
At least one startup will receive a €40K investment at the end of the program in the form of a SAFE (alternatively a CLA, depending on the country the startup is based in).
During the program, 21 startups from 13 CEE countries took on intensive training, which culminated in a Demo Day, where two of them managed to secure a total of €40,000 investment.

analyst_notes: Free, fully online accelerator (6th programme running) for European idea and pre-seed startups, founded in Prague by the advisory firm Accace (Accace entities at Hvězdova 1716/2b, Praha 4 - the site's Nusle address) and ZAKA VC (record zaka-vc); lectures by ZAKA and Accace staff; the investment committee is led by ZAKA's Head of Investment Committee. The programme page says selected startups receive EUR 40k 'from AceON' as a SAFE/CLA, and participants sign an agreement giving AceON a right to invest later. Fourth programme (15 Oct - 28 Nov 2024) ended with two winners receiving EUR 40,000 in total (Georgian ARtttify, Portuguese SentiVue; AIN.UA 2024-12-06, quoting ZAKA's Ján Kasper as 'one of the investors'); investment date set to the demo-day end date 2024-11-28 (the article gives the programme dates, not the transfer date). Unverified because the investing entity is not disclosed: ARES has no AceON company (ACEON s.r.o., Zbuzany, is unrelated) and it is not shown whether the SAFEs are signed by an Accace entity, ZAKA VC I (21514992) or a separate vehicle. If the tickets come from ZAKA VC this is a programme of zaka-vc (E10); even with an entity it would fail the Czech scope rule (no Czech portfolio company found -> S2). Sector: generalist programme, not stated. Ticket EUR 40k (AIN: EUR 40k shared by two startups in 2024; 2023 programme offered EUR 50-70k per press reports, not verified).
